literal: Greatly comforting and lovingly uniting, (and then) with difficulty enduring, possesses the nature of planning an absence of love.
translation: His excessive comforting and loving embrace, followed by a strained, difficult endurance, reveals a hidden design to depart, showing a lack of love.
modern: மிகவும் ஆறுதல் கூறி அன்போடு கூடுதல், பின்னர் பிரிவைத் தாங்குவது போல வருந்துதல் ஆகிய இரண்டும், என்னைப் பிரிய நினைக்கும் அன்பில்லாத தன்மையைக் குறிப்பதாகும்.
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine reads the subtle behavioral signs of her lover. She notices that his sudden, unusually intense affection and comforting embrace are followed by a strained, difficult endurance. She realizes that this dramatic shift in behavior is not just ordinary affection, but a sign that he is mentally preparing himself for separation. Thus, she concludes that his actions betray a plan to leave her, which she views as a lack of true love.
